title: Appearance
description: The cooperative's name, logo and colours. The other shades (dark mode included) are chosen automatically so text stays readable.
loadFailed: The appearance settings could not be loaded.
orgNameHint: Empty: “{name}”. Shown in the menu, on the home page and in the tab title.
brandAdjusted: Brand colour darkened so text stays readable.
accentAdjusted: Accent colour adjusted so text stays readable.
saved: Saved. Members will see the changes the next time a page loads.
resetBody: The name, logo and colours go back to “{name}” for everyone. The uploaded logo will be deleted.

logo.title: Logo
logo.none: No logo: the menu shows the cooperative's mark.
logo.hint: PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 2 MB (no SVG). The image is saved again, without metadata, at up to 512 × 128 pixels; the browser tab icon is made from it.

errors.contrast_unreachable: With this colour, text would not be readable in any shade. Choose another.
errors.name_too_long: The name can be at most 60 characters long.
errors.name_invalid: The name contains characters that are not allowed (such as control characters).
errors.type_not_allowed: Only PNG, JPEG or WebP images are allowed (SVG is not supported).
errors.logo_type: Only PNG, JPEG or WebP images are allowed.
errors.extension_mismatch: The file extension does not match its content.
errors.content_type_mismatch: The file type does not match its content.
errors.too_large: The file is too large (2 MB at most).
errors.dimensions: The image is too large (4096 × 4096 pixels at most).
errors.unreadable_image: The image could not be read.
errors.infected: The virus scanner rejected the file.
errors.scanner_unavailable: The virus scanner is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.
errors.rate_limited: Too many changes within an hour. Please try later.
errors.mfa: This action needs a sign-in with MFA.
errors.failed: The changes could not be saved.
